content.short: Narfex is a decentralized peer-to-peer fiat-to-cryptocurrency protocol.
content.description: Narfex enables users to trade a broad range of digital assets securely and efficiently without relying on centralized intermediaries. It addresses the trust, transparency, and security challenges that traditional peer-to-peer exchanges often face. By leveraging smart contracts, trades are automatically executed once both parties fulfill their obligations, eliminating the need to rely on a trusted third party and delivering trust-minimized, verifiable settlement of trades. This approach reduces counterparty risk and supports direct, autonomous trade completion.
